svg.title: Instrumentos: stack tecnológico
svg.desc: Ficha técnica do stack por grupo — Linguagens: Python, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, C#, PHP, Kotlin; Frameworks e bibliotecas: React, Next.js, Angular, Vue, Node.js, FastAPI, Spring, Flutter, Laravel, Express, NestJS, Django, GraphQL, Redux, Prisma, Jest; Dados e storage: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, SQLite, Elasticsearch, Supabase, Firebase; Nuvem e infraestrutura: AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Nginx, Linux; Ferramentas: Git, GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Figma, VS Code, Postman, Grafana.
